name: Peco Setrack Code 100
description: Peco Setrack OO/HO gauge sectional track in Code 100 rail. Fixed-geometry pieces designed for set-track (Set Track) layouts, compatible with Hornby OO sectional track via standard rail-joiners and identical 16.5 mm gauge. Setrack curves are sold by Peco as 1st through 4th radius; the same UK 1st/2nd/3rd/4th convention is used by Hornby (R-numbers). Combine with Streamline Code 100 for plain track and finer turnouts.

pieces.notes: Setrack left-hand point. Diverging route is geometrically equivalent to a 2nd-radius half-curve (438 mm R, 22.5 deg). Frog number not published by Peco for Setrack points; null.

pieces.notes: Setrack right-hand point. Diverging route equivalent to a 2nd-radius half-curve (438 mm R, 22.5 deg).

pieces.label: Curved Left-Hand Turnout (2nd/3rd Radius)
pieces.notes: Setrack curved left point: inner route 2nd radius (438 mm), outer route 3rd radius (505 mm). Overall length and exact arc not separately published; treat as a 2nd/3rd radius double-curve substitute. TODO: verify centre-line length on a manufacturer datasheet.

pieces.label: Curved Right-Hand Turnout (2nd/3rd Radius)
pieces.notes: Curved right point. Inner 2nd radius, outer 3rd radius. Length not separately published; null.

pieces.label: Y Turnout (Setrack)
pieces.notes: Symmetric Y point; both routes diverge at half the standard 22.5 deg from centreline (i.e. 11.25 deg each side, total 22.5 deg).

pieces.label: Crossing 90 deg
pieces.notes: Right-angle (90 deg) diamond crossing. Length matches standard straight.
